panel-title.purpose: Shape library and contextual property headings.

body.purpose: Regular editor content and property values.

metadata.purpose: Source revision, save status, hints, and counts.

motion.name: connection-handle-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal ports during hover, selection, and keyboard focus; connection tasks keep ports visible.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Shared command feedback; pressed feedback has no transition delay and reduced-motion removes transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Commit a local editor action such as adding a connection.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--diagram-primary, #0071e3); color: var(--diagram-on-primary, #ffffff); } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--diagram-primary-hover, #0066cc); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-primary:active { opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet toolbar action; the pressed state identifies an active tool.
components.css: .ds-ghost { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); padding: 0 10px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--diagram-secondary, #dce5f2); } .ds-ghost:hover { background: var(--diagram-hover, #ffffff0c); } .ds-ghost[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--diagram-selected, #244a71); color: var(--diagram-accent-text, #9ecbff); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-ghost:active { background: var(--diagram-active, #48484a); opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-ghost:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ghost { transition: none; } }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Secondary document action such as exporting or duplicating a shape.
components.css: .ds-outline { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); background: var(--diagram-surface, #2c2c2e); color: var(--diagram-secondary, #dce5f2); border: 1px solid var(--diagram-control-line, #636369); } .ds-outline:hover { border-color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 217 18% 74%) / .5); } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-outline:active { opacity: .75; transition-duration: 0ms; } .ds-outline:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-outline { transition: none; } }

components.name: Property Field
components.description: Theme-aware inspector field for editable dimensions and diagram properties.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; width: 148px; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--diagram-secondary, #dce5f2); font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-field-label span { color: var(--diagram-muted, #b2bbc9); font-size: 10px; } .ds-field { width: 148px; height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--diagram-control-line, #636369); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--diagram-field, #323235); color: var(--diagram-text, #f5f5f7); font: 400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; box-shadow: none; caret-color: var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: hsl(210 100% 45% / .35); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); outline-offset: -2px; border-color: hsl(210 100% 45% / .7); } .ds-field:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-field { font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Color Control
components.description: Quick editor: Native picker, six-digit HEX input, and existing swatches for stroke or optional fill colors.
components.css: .ds-color-control { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 9px; max-width: 232px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-color-control label { color: var(--diagram-secondary, #dce5f2); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-color-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; } .ds-color-row input { border: 1px solid var(--diagram-control-line, #636369); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--diagram-field, #323235); color: var(--diagram-text, #f5f5f7); font: 400 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; caret-color: var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); } .ds-color-row input[type="color"] { width: 46px; min-width: 46px; height: 44px; padding: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-color-hex { flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 38px; padding: 10px 16px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-color-row input:focus-visible, .ds-color-swatches button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-color-swatches { display: flex; } .ds-color-swatches button { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; min-width: 36px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-color-swatches button:hover { background: var(--diagram-hover, #ffffff0c); } .ds-color-swatches button:active { opacity: .75; } .ds-color-swatches button > span { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--diagram-swatch-line, #ffffff35); } .ds-color-swatches button[aria-pressed="true"] > span { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-color-swatches svg { position: absolute; color: #152329; } .ds-color-control input:disabled, .ds-color-control button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-color-hex { font-size: 16px; } .ds-color-swatches button { width: 44px; min-width: 44px; } }

components.name: Command Bar
components.description: Quick editor: Grouped document commands above the drawing canvas.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 49px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--diagram-chrome, #242426); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--diagram-line, #454548); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-toolbar-group { padding-right: 6px; border-right: 1px solid var(--diagram-line, #454548); } .ds-toolbar button { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: var(--diagram-secondary, #dce5f2); font: 500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toolbar button:hover { background: var(--diagram-hover, #ffffff0c); } .ds-toolbar button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-toolbar button:active { background: var(--diagram-active, #48484a); opacity: .75; } .ds-toolbar .ds-toolbar-active { background: var(--diagram-selected, #244a71); color: var(--diagram-accent-text, #9ecbff); } @media (max-width: 1050px) { .ds-toolbar { overflow-x: auto; } }

components.name: Shape Card
components.description: Quick editor: Eight shapes: four basic shapes plus resistor, capacitor, ground, and an editable Net Name tag. Circuit icon paths match the shared source graphics.
components.css: .ds-shapes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 72px); gap: 8px; } .ds-shape-blue { --shape-color: var(--diagram-shape-blue, #80b9ff); --shape-fill: var(--diagram-shape-blue-fill, #203e62); } .ds-shape-teal { --shape-color: var(--diagram-shape-teal, #79dfd0); --shape-fill: var(--diagram-shape-teal-fill, #1f4647); } .ds-shape-violet { --shape-color: var(--diagram-shape-violet, #cab1f0); --shape-fill: var(--diagram-shape-violet-fill, #393350); } .ds-shape-amber { --shape-color: var(--diagram-shape-amber, #e8c685); --shape-fill: var(--diagram-shape-amber-fill, #4c3e28); } .ds-shape-neutral { --shape-color: var(--diagram-secondary, #dce5f2); --shape-fill: var(--diagram-surface, #2c2c2e); } .ds-shape { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 72px; height: 88px; padding: 10px 4px; border: 1px solid var(--diagram-line, #454548); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--shape-fill); color: var(--diagram-secondary, #dce5f2); font: 400 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-shape svg { color: var(--shape-color); } .ds-shape:hover { background: var(--diagram-selected, #244a71); border-color: var(--shape-color); } .ds-shape:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--diagram-accent, #69afff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-shape:active { opacity: .75; } .ds-shape:disabled { opacity: .38; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-shapes { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-shape { width: auto; height: 48px; padding: 4px; flex-direction: row; gap: 5px; border: 0; font-size: 11px; } .ds-shape svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } }

components.name: Saved Document Card
components.description: Quick editor: Open an account-local document from the saved-document dialog.
components.css: .ds-saved { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 68px; padding: 12px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(var(--secondary, 240 3% 20%)); color: var(--diagram-text, #f5f5f7); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-saved:hover { border-color: hsl(210 100% 45%); } .ds-saved:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(210 100% 45%); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-saved:active { opacity: .75; } .ds-saved:disabled { opacity: .5; } .ds-saved > svg { flex-shrink: 0; color: hsl(210 100% 45%); } .ds-saved > span:not(.ds-saved-check) { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; min-width: 0; } .ds-saved strong { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-saved small { font-size: 11px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 217 18% 74%)); } .ds-saved-check { color: hsl(210 100% 45%); }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: Quick editor: Theme-aware passive text feedback for the selected object or active connection task.
components.css: .ds-selection-chip { display: inline-block; color: var(--diagram-accent-text, #9ecbff); background: var(--diagram-selected, #244a71); border: 1px solid var(--diagram-selected-line, #5d8dbd); border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 8px; font: 400 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; pointer-events: none; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-selection-chip { font-size: 10px; } }

narrative.overview:
The default workspace embeds the official draw.io editor and its full shape libraries inside the existing AutoCheck document shell. The retained “快速繪圖” editor pairs the familiar workbench arrangement with Apple-inspired neutral graphite backgrounds and a light variant. Brighter blue identifies host and quick-editor actions, focus, and selection; colored basic shapes and circuit symbols give the quick editor's eight-item library recognizable roles.

This record applies to the host document shell, quick editor, and their menus and dialogs. The official cross-origin DRAWIO frame retains its own interface; its internals are not styled by the host stylesheet. The surrounding AutoCheck website keeps its incumbent design. The record follows the implemented components and stylesheet rather than prescribing a new website identity.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral graphite canvas and tools by default, with a complete light variant.
Compact system typography and explicit control labels.
The official full DRAWIO workspace by default, with the existing eight-shape quick editor available separately.
A persistent, color-coded shape library with contextual editing properties in the quick editor.
Direct movement, drag-to-draw arrows, visible connection handles, and reversible edits.
Responsive tools that keep the drawing workspace usable on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Scoped Color Rule
rules.body: Apply the same `data-diagram-theme` to the host shell, quick editor, and their portaled menus and dialogs; preserve the surrounding site's colors.

rules.name: The Contextual Properties Rule
rules.body: In the quick editor, reserve the inspector for the selected object or active connection task so the unselected canvas receives the available width.

dos: **Do** preserve the shape-library, canvas, and contextual-inspector arrangement.
**Do** use blue for actions, focus, and active editor controls while neutral surfaces carry structure.
**Do** theme portaled editor menus and dialogs alongside the embedded editor.
**Do** keep both canvas appearances legible with mode-aware drawing-color helpers and preserve the white page for portable exports.
**Do** retain visible saved-state feedback and separate `.drawio` / editable JSON backup instructions.
**Do** distinguish network-dependent DRAWIO loading from account-local document persistence.
donts: **Don't** apply this scoped editor palette to the surrounding AutoCheck website.
**Don't** make the inspector a permanent empty column when there is no selected object or active connection task.
**Don't** rely on color alone for selected swatches, current saved documents, or disabled editing capability.
**Don't** remove the narrow-screen property pane or accessible command names when simplifying the toolbar.
**Don't** persist appearance preferences or invisible canvas endpoint helpers inside diagram documents.
**Don't** flatten imported DRAWIO files into quick-editor shapes or imply that edited local documents are included in comparison backups.
